subject.title: [Bug] Webchat avatar endpoint /avatar/{agentId} returns 404 even with valid IDENTITY.md avatar

question: Should local avatar failures expose clearer user-facing diagnostics through metadata/UI only, or should the direct /avatar/{agentId} endpoint itself return more specific failure statuses?
rationale: The remaining behavior sits on an authenticated local workspace file-serving route, so clearer feedback improves UX but can change information-disclosure boundaries and security expectations.

options.title: Improve UI diagnostics only
options.body: Keep direct image fetches conservative while using existing avatarStatus/avatarReason metadata and Control UI surfaces to show safe oversized or missing-file guidance.

options.title: Expose endpoint-specific errors
options.body: Return specific statuses such as 413 or 400 from /avatar/{agentId} with tests proving no unsafe path details leak.

options.title: Fold into broader avatar contract
options.body: Defer this local diagnostics choice into the broader remote/local avatar policy tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41201.

recommendation.title: Improve UI diagnostics only
recommendation.body: Keep direct image fetches conservative while using existing avatarStatus/avatarReason metadata and Control UI surfaces to show safe oversized or missing-file guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across the resolver, local avatar policy, and gateway avatar route hardening.
